abstract: # Motion-based-Self-Reflection-Framework [Project Page](https://xwinks.github.io/motion_instruction_for_correction/) [Arxiv](https://www.arxiv.org/abs/2504.14588) ## Overview In this work, we propose a motion-based self-reflection framework for fine-grained robotic action correction, which leverages motion instruction as a bridge to connect high-level semantic reflection with low-level robotic action correction. Concretely, we borrow the inferential capability of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for motion instruction correction, and propose a multi-task motion-conditioned diffusion policy for low-level robotic action correction. The results prove the effectiveness of our method: ## Installation First, install the simulation environment, please refer to the [mimicgen documentation](https://mimicgen.github.io/docs/introduction/installation.html) for more details: ### MimicGen Installation ### Robosuite Installation ### Robomimic Installation ### Robosuite_task_zoo Installation ### Llava Installation please refer to the [Llava Documentation](https://github.com/haotian-liu/LLaVA): ## Usage ### Motion Instruction Generation To train our motion prediction module, motion correction module, and the corresponding motion-conditioned diffusion policy, we need to annotate the trajectories with their corresponding motion instruction. #### Dataset for Motion-conditioned Diffusion Policy 1. Mimicgen Dataset Download Here we utilize "Coffee_D0" task for example: 2. Motion Instruction Generation This script will generate the motion information and save it in the adjust_llava_motion folder. 3. Data Format Conversion To improve model training efficiency and GPU utilization, we found that the original hdf5 format stores the entire trajectory as a single meta information, which causes redundant observation and action information to be read during __getitem__ calls. abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于运动的自反射框架，用于细粒度的机器人动作修正，该框架利用运动指令作为桥梁，将高层语义反思与低层机器人动作修正连接起来。具体而言，我们借用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的推理能力进行运动指令修正，并提出了一种多任务运动条件扩散策略用于低层机器人动作修正。结果证明了我们方法的有效性。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出基于运动的自我反思框架：以“运动指令”为桥梁，先用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对运动指令进行高层语义纠正，再用多任务运动条件扩散策略生成对应的低层机器人动作。


# 一、动机

> 机器人精细动作纠正中，高层语义反思与低层动作控制之间存在鸿沟，难以直接利用多模态大模型的推理结果生成可执行的精确动作。


# 二、方法

> 提出基于运动的自我反思框架：以“运动指令”为桥梁，先用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对运动指令进行高层语义纠正，再用多任务运动条件扩散策略生成对应的低层机器人动作。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在MimicGen等仿真环境（如Coffee任务）中验证了方法的有效性，但摘要中未给出具体的量化数值指标。


# 四、对我的启发

> 运动指令作为中间表示可有效衔接语义推理与动作生成，值得借鉴。与课题相关（具身智能/机器人操作）。
